versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "gmail-to-outlook" skill.
- Provides step-by-step guidance for migrating email, contacts, and calendars from Google Workspace (Gmail) to Microsoft 365 (Outlook/Exchange Online).
- Covers multiple migration methods: Microsoft Data Migration Service (bulk/org-wide), Google Takeout (MBOX), and IMAP bridge for small-scale/personal accounts.
- Includes pre-migration checklists, DNS/MX cutover procedures, post-migration validation steps, common troubleshooting tips, and client deliverable templates.
- Supports both single-user and bulk/org-wide migrations.
